description: React single-page app built with Vite and strict TypeScript.

features: React 19 single-page app with Vite, strict TypeScript and React Router
prerequisites: Node.js 22.22 or newer (Vite 8, React Router 8 and the test tools need it)

scripts.dev: Starts the development server on http://localhost:5173
scripts.lint: Checks lint rules and formatting with Biome
scripts.format: Formats files and applies safe lint fixes with Biome

sections.title: Formatting and linting
sections.body: Biome formats and lints the project; `{{ runScript }} lint` fails on any difference. `@biomejs/biome` is pinned to an exact version because Biome's formatting output can change between releases, which would otherwise make `lint` fail on a fresh project.
